Package be.imgn.toml

@NullMarked package be.imgn.toml
Parsing and writing TOML 1.1 documents.

Toml parses a document into a TomlDocument, whose root TomlTable it writes back, and whose TomlPositions tell where its keys and values are written. Every value is a TomlValue. It also binds a document to a record annotated TomlConfig, through the code the be.imgn.toml:toml-processor annotation processor generates.
